messages:
Maria (eng-security): Quick check — SOC2 milestone is next Wed. Need final signoff on two things: auditlog ingestion end-to-end and KMS/HSM key-rotation evidence. Owners: @Kevin for audit pipeline, @Olivia for non-prod HSM access, @Darren for evidence pack. Please ack and call out blockers.

Kevin (eng-platform): Ack. Primary blocker is vendor log format mapping (CloudWatch -> normalizer). I opened PR #1723 for the normalizer mapping changes (https://git.company/pr/1723). ETA to address review comments: Thu EOD.

Olivia (eng-sre): Non-prod HSM access tickets created: JIRA-SEC-334 and JIRA-OPS-778. Need infra approval for the service account. Also propose a smoke window Tue 10-11 PT to validate ingest. @Maria can you confirm table-top timing? :calendar:

Darren (security): Evidence pack draft uploaded to Google Drive (link in private doc). I pushed docs changes in docs repo: PR #1759 — still needs control-owner reviews. Need confirmation on key rotation proof artifacts (signed wrapping keys + rotation logs).

Maria (eng-security): Thanks. Can we prioritize the CR queue for the normalizer? @Kevin please ping reviewers on #eng-platform and tag flaky tests. Quick verification command we use for ingestion checks: ```gcloud logging read 'resource.type="gce_instance"' --limit 10``` — run this against staging to confirm entries.

Ben (eng-platform): I can review PR #1723 today. Noted flaky test `test-normalizer-integration` — I'll try to reproduce locally and leave comments.

deploy-bot: Reminder: Fieldwork window scheduled for 2026-04-21 to 2026-04-23. Please attach evidence to tickets by 2026-04-18.

Olivia (eng-sre): Smoke window Tue 10-11 PT works for me. I'll reserve the staging cluster and run the ingest smoke script. Anyone who wants to join, lmk. :thumbsup:

Nate (product): No objections from product side. We need audit-log availability for feature flag telemetry queries by EOW.

Maria (eng-security): OK — milestone label `audit-ingest-ready` set. Target: green by Tue EOD. Owners: Kevin, Olivia. Dependencies: vendor mapping PR (#1723), k8s sidecar patch (DEP-401), HSM access (JIRA-SEC-334). If you can't hit this, call it out by EOD today so we can triage scope.

Kevin (eng-platform): Will update PR status and JIRA tickets by 18:00 PT today. If I run into blocker from vendor schema we'll escalate.

Darren (security): I'll add the evidence checklist to the doc and @mention control owners for quick reviews. Planning to attach rotation logs and signed key attestations to JIRA-SEC-334.

Maria (eng-security): Thanks all. Action items summary: 1) Kevin — expedite PR #1723 & update JIRA; 2) Olivia — run smoke Tue and confirm cluster reservation; 3) Darren — push evidence checklist and assign reviewers; 4) Ben — review PR & chase flaky test. If anyone needs help, drop notes here.

Ben (eng-platform): On it, will post review comments in the PR thread.

Kevin (eng-platform): Ping me if you need me to pair on the normalizer tests.

Maria (eng-security): Closing loop for now. We'll reconvene async — if status changes post-EOD, update JIRA and ping this thread. :white_check_mark:
